intro.en: Every chauffeur is verified before their first assignment and re-checked periodically.

items.en: Valid driving licence verified against the issuing authority
CNIC verified and copied to the personnel file
items.ur: شناختی کارڈ کی تصدیق اور ریکارڈ میں شامل

items.en: Police character verification completed before first duty
items.ur: پہلی ڈیوٹی سے قبل پولیس کریکٹر سرٹیفکیٹ مکمل

items.en: Employment references checked and recorded
items.ur: ملازمت کے حوالہ جات کی جانچ اور ریکارڈ

items.en: Periodic re-verification of licence validity and record
items.ur: لائسنس کی مدت اور ریکارڈ کی وقتاً فوقتاً تصدیق

intro.en: A documented pre-trip inspection is filed before every departure.

items.en: Brakes, tyres, lights, horn, mirrors and wipers checked
items.ur: بریک، ٹائر، لائٹس، ہارن، آئینے اور وائپرز کی جانچ

items.en: Engine oil, coolant and fuel levels confirmed
items.ur: انجن آئل، کولنٹ اور ایندھن کی سطح کی تصدیق

items.en: First aid kit and fire extinguisher present and in date
items.ur: فرسٹ ایڈ کٹ اور آگ بجھانے کا آلہ موجود اور کارآمد

items.en: Spare tyre, jack, wheel spanner and emergency tools on board
GPS tracker and mobile communication device operational
items.ur: GPS ٹریکر اور موبائل رابطہ آلہ فعال

items.en: Any failed item logged with a note and resolved before departure

intro.en: Movements are planned and monitored by the 24/7 Operations Control Room.

items.en: Routes planned before departure, with alternates for long or sensitive movements
GPS tracking monitored throughout the journey
items.ur: پورے سفر کے دوران GPS ٹریکنگ کی نگرانی

items.en: Scheduled check-ins on intercity and field routes
items.ur: بین الاضلاعی اور فیلڈ روٹس پر مقررہ رابطہ

items.en: Night-travel and no-go-hour rules enforced where clients require them
Immediate escalation path from driver to operations to client focal point

intro.en: Professional conduct is a contract condition, not a courtesy.

items.en: Punctual, presentable and courteous at all times
items.ur: ہر وقت وقت کا پابند، بااخلاق اور مہذب

items.en: No smoking in vehicles; phones on hands-free for operations calls only
Speed limits and traffic law observed without exception
items.ur: رفتار کی حد اور ٹریفک قوانین کی بلا استثنا پابندی

items.en: Passenger instructions followed within the agreed journey plan
Confidentiality: what is said or seen in the vehicle stays in the vehicle

intro.en: Simple habits that keep passengers safe on every trip.
intro.ur: سادہ عادات جو ہر سفر میں مسافروں کو محفوظ رکھتی ہیں۔

items.en: Doors locked during travel; windows managed by passenger preference
Identity of waiting passengers confirmed before departure
items.ur: روانگی سے قبل منتظر مسافروں کی شناخت کی تصدیق

items.en: Luggage loaded and unloaded by the driver, checked before leaving
No unauthorized passengers or unplanned stops
items.ur: غیر مجاز مسافر یا غیر طے شدہ رکاوٹ ممنوع

items.en: Seatbelts required for all occupants
items.ur: تمام سواروں کے لیے سیٹ بیلٹ لازمی

intro.en: When something goes wrong, the response is procedure, not improvisation.

items.en: Driver secures passengers first, then reports to the Operations Control Room
Breakdowns: replacement vehicle dispatched immediately; passengers never stranded
Accidents: scene safety, medical assistance, police involvement per law, full incident report
Medical emergencies: nearest appropriate facility, client focal point informed en route
All incidents documented with photos and closed with a resolution note

title.ur: زیادہ خطرے اور VIP کے طریقہ کار

intro.en: Elevated-threat and protocol movements run under additional controls.

items.en: Security-trained drivers with defensive and evasive driving instruction
B-6 armored vehicles available as the fleet standard for protected movement
Route reconnaissance and timing rehearsals for formal protocol movements
Convoy and escort coordination with client security details
items.ur: کلائنٹ کے سیکیورٹی عملے کے ساتھ قافلہ اور حفاظتی رابطہ

items.en: Movement details shared on a strict need-to-know basis
items.ur: نقل و حرکت کی تفصیلات سختی سے ضرورت کی بنیاد پر

intro.en: Verification happens in person, at pickup. The site never collects document uploads.

items.en: Original CNIC (or passport for foreign nationals) presented and verified
Valid driving licence presented and verified — no licence, no handover
Rental agreement and security declaration signed at the counter
Security deposit confirmed per the agreement
items.ur: معاہدے کے مطابق سیکیورٹی رقم کی تصدیق

items.en: Only the verified renter and named additional drivers may drive

intro.en: The handover inspection protects the renter as much as the company.

items.en: Exterior and interior condition inspected jointly with the renter
Fuel level and odometer reading recorded and agreed
items.ur: ایندھن اور میٹر ریڈنگ کا اندراج اور اتفاق

items.en: Existing damages noted and photographed together before departure
Accessories and tools checklist confirmed (spare tyre, jack, documents)
Renter signs the inspection record and receives the summary
items.ur: کرایہ دار معائنہ ریکارڈ پر دستخط کرکے خلاصہ وصول کرتا ہے

intro.en: Clear rules, agreed in writing, so there are no surprises at return.

items.en: Vehicle driven only by the verified renter and named drivers
No racing, contests, towing or any illegal use
items.ur: ریس، مقابلہ، ٹوئنگ یا کوئی غیر قانونی استعمال ممنوع

items.en: Travel limited to the agreed geographical area; written approval required to extend
Vehicle kept locked and parked securely when unattended
items.ur: گاڑی غیر موجودگی میں مقفل اور محفوظ کھڑی رکھی جائے

items.en: Zero tolerance for driving under the influence of alcohol or intoxicants

intro.en: Self-drive renters are backed by the same 24/7 operations room as our chauffeured fleet.

items.en: 24/7 breakdown helpline printed on the agreement and in the vehicle
Accidents reported immediately to the helpline and to police as required by law
Do not admit liability or settle at the scene; the operations room guides next steps
Replacement or recovery arranged per the agreement terms
items.ur: معاہدے کے مطابق متبادل یا ریکوری کا انتظام

intro.en: The rental closes the way it opened — jointly, and on the record.

items.en: Joint return inspection against the handover record
items.ur: حوالگی ریکارڈ کے مطابق مشترکہ واپسی معائنہ

items.en: Fuel level and odometer recorded and compared
items.ur: ایندھن اور میٹر ریڈنگ کا اندراج اور موازنہ

items.en: New damages, if any, assessed transparently per the agreement
Fines or penalties incurred during the rental are the renter's responsibility
Deposit released per the agreement once the inspection closes clean

intro.en: Some rules have no exceptions, for anyone, on any contract.
intro.ur: کچھ اصولوں میں کسی کے لیے، کسی معاہدے پر کوئی استثنا نہیں۔

items.en: No alcohol or intoxicants — drivers or self-drive renters
items.ur: ڈرائیور یا خود ڈرائیو کرنے والوں کے لیے نشہ آور اشیاء ممنوع

items.en: No unauthorized use of client vehicles or client information
No cash handling or errands outside the agreed journey plan
items.ur: طے شدہ سفری منصوبے سے باہر رقم یا کام کی اجازت نہیں

items.en: Violations end assignments immediately and are reported to the client

intro.en: Clients discuss business in our vehicles. That fact shapes our contracts.

items.en: Driver confidentiality is a written condition of employment
items.ur: ڈرائیور کی رازداری ملازمت کی تحریری شرط ہے

items.en: Movement details shared on a need-to-know basis only
items.ur: نقل و حرکت کی تفصیلات صرف ضرورت کی بنیاد پر

items.en: No photography or disclosure of client activities
items.ur: کلائنٹ کی سرگرمیوں کی تصویر کشی یا افشا ممنوع

items.en: Client data handled per the service agreement and never re-used

intro.en: Reliability is scheduled, not hoped for.
intro.ur: بھروسہ اتفاق نہیں، منصوبہ بندی کا نتیجہ ہے۔

items.en: Documented preventive maintenance for every vehicle
items.ur: ہر گاڑی کی دستاویزی احتیاطی دیکھ بھال

items.en: Service records retained and auditable per vehicle
items.ur: ہر گاڑی کا سروس ریکارڈ محفوظ اور قابلِ آڈٹ

items.en: Tyres, brakes and safety systems replaced on wear thresholds, not failure
Vehicles rotated out of service for scheduled maintenance without client impact

intro.en: Every vehicle reports its position to the Operations Control Room.

items.en: Fleet-wide GPS tracking, monitored 24/7
items.ur: پوری فلیٹ پر GPS ٹریکنگ، 24/7 نگرانی

items.en: Movement history retained for client reporting and investigations
Geo-fencing and route-deviation alerts on managed journeys
items.ur: منظم سفر پر جیو فینسنگ اور راستہ تبدیلی کی اطلاع

items.en: Tracking data available to corporate clients under agreement

intro.en: Standards decay without reinforcement, so training is recurring.

items.en: Defensive-driving training with periodic refreshers
items.ur: دفاعی ڈرائیونگ تربیت اور وقتاً فوقتاً تجدید

items.en: Client-specific inductions (HSE, safeguarding, protocol) before assignment
First-aid and emergency-response basics for all drivers
items.ur: تمام ڈرائیوروں کے لیے ابتدائی طبی امداد اور ہنگامی تربیت

items.en: Conduct and confidentiality briefings repeated annually
items.ur: طرزِ عمل اور رازداری کی سالانہ بریفنگ

intro.en: We audit our own compliance the way our clients audit us.
intro.ur: ہم اپنی پابندی کا اسی طرح آڈٹ کرتے ہیں جیسے ہمارے کلائنٹ ہمارا کرتے ہیں۔

items.en: Periodic internal audits of driver files, inspections and incident records
Client audits and site inspections welcomed under agreement
items.ur: معاہدے کے تحت کلائنٹ آڈٹ اور سائٹ معائنہ خوش آمدید

items.en: Corrective actions tracked to closure
items.ur: اصلاحی اقدامات کی تکمیل تک نگرانی

items.en: Protocol reviewed and updated annually
items.ur: پروٹوکول کا سالانہ جائزہ اور تجدید
